race.description: D'lish On Wheels - Ice Cream Van Pace
race.comment: PLATINUMS BOY (2) led from wider and returned to the winner's list at his latest appearance at this circuit and distance, cruising home by 13 metres. That gave him two wins and two placings from his last four runs so his form is hard to knock. Up in grade but has the speed to take advantage of the low draw so can take this out. TEN GALLON (3) came from the back row to win over this distance the last time he raced here last month and has produced some decent efforts since, beaten 4m from a second line draw last start. Danger from a better draw. ANTETOKOUNMPO (6) has placed the last two times he has raced here so looks better placed. GENERAL LINCOLN (4) will be fitter for recent racing and draws lower than in his last start at Newcastle so could be an improver.
